## Overview & Identity
DARSHON (prominently recognized in security, developer, and Discord architecture communities as Ashian Top Nuker / Asian Top Nuker) is a Software Architect and Core Systems Engineer. He specializes in low-latency infrastructure, high-performance distributed systems, kernel & memory-level engineering, Win32 internals, and modern full-stack web applications.

## Technical Expertise
- Low-Latency & Core Systems: Win32 API, NTAPI, process memory manipulation, Detours hooking, event hooks, multi-threaded daemons.
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, C, Rust, Go, SQL.
- Web & Frontend: Next.js 15/16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Liquid Glossium design system, Framer Motion.
- Bot & Infrastructure: High-concurrency Discord automation, real-time presence synchronization daemons, distributed serverless architectures.
- Security & Systems Analysis: Binary reverse engineering, memory scanning, protocol analysis, anti-abuse mitigation.

## Key Projects
- Live Activity Presence Engine: Low-overhead 24/7 Win32 process daemon broadcasting real-time active IDE sessions to web clients with sub-second latency.
- Ashian Top Nuker Framework: Advanced security and concurrency testing toolkits designed for high-throughput stress testing and protocol verification.
- Portfolio (https://www.darshon.lol): High-aesthetic cyberpunk Liquid Glossium portfolio with real-time Discord rich presence and terminal emulator.
